title_sq: Shitet Penthouse Tek Tregu Elektrik 2+1 Me Pamje Spektakolare!
description_sq: Shitet Penthouse tregu elektrik 2+1 me Pamje Spektakolare!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 nga 9 totalet si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 231 m2, nga ku siperfaqja e apartamentit eshte 121 m2 dhe veranda 110 m2. Prona organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni i bollshem, kendi i gatimit se bashku me nje depo, dhoma matrimoniale me garderoben, dhoma te tjera gjumi, veranda e cila aksesohet nga te gjitha dhomat. Orientimi i prones eshte Jug-Lindje. Prona eshte e investuar, me sistem ngrohje/ftohje, izolim akustik, vetrata dopioxham etj. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: Penthouse for sale at the Electric Market 2+1 with Spectacular View!
description_en: Electric market Penthouse 2+1 with Spectacular View for sale!!! The apartment is located on the 6th floor out of 9 total and has a gross surface of 231 m2, of which the surface of the apartment is 121 m2 and the veranda 110 m2. The property is organized by a distribution corridor, a spacious living room, a kitchen area together with a storage room, a matrimonial room with a wardrobe, other bedrooms, a veranda which is accessed from all the rooms. The orientation of the property is South-East. The property is invested, with a heating/cooling system, acoustic insulation, double-glazed windows, etc. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
